journeys.name: a-synthetic-reading-announces-itself
assertions: a reading whose series_source is 'synthetic' renders the visible marker, and the marker text resolves from dictionary.md
the marker is read from the reading's own series_source, not from the entry mode or any client-side guess
no prop, flag or query parameter suppresses the marker on a synthetic reading
the marker's colour comes from packages/theme tokens; no literal colour is declared

journeys.name: a-measured-reading-carries-no-marker
assertions: a reading whose series_source is 'measured' renders no marker at all
flipping the header between Thu nghiem and Dang nhap does not by itself add or remove the marker — only the reading's own provenance does

journeys.name: absent-provenance-fails-closed
assertions: a reading arriving without series_source renders as unprovenanced and is never presented as measured
the unprovenanced state is visually distinct from the measured state, not merely the absence of a marker where a number still reads as real

migrationCompatibility.notes: No migration. impact_readings.series_source already exists as a NOT NULL enum with no default (ADR-099 decision 2). This slice only surfaces a column that is already written and enforced.

rollbackAssertion.postCutoverFailureBehavior: repoint the nginx demo upstream to the retained previous release; readings revert whole, never half-marked

doNotInfer: The marker must read series_source from the reading itself. Deriving it from the entry mode, the demo/replay flag, or any client-side heuristic fails AC2 — a signed-in seller looking at genuinely synthetic data must still see it.

Fail closed. A reading with NO series_source renders as unprovenanced, never as measured. The column deliberately has no default so a writer that forgets provenance fails; do not reintroduce a default in the view layer.

The marker must not be suppressible by a prop or flag. AC6 exists because an optional honesty marker is not an honesty marker. Do not add an escape hatch 'for tests' — drive the tests through series_source.
Do NOT edit packages/theme/run-surface-tokens.css. If a token you need is missing, report it rather than adding one.
Use color-mix, never rgba(). #1912's token-only-theming test fails on a literal colour, blur or shadow in any rule added here.

dictionary.md's _Avoid_ field is SPLIT ON COMMAS — a comma inside a parenthetical produces inert fragments that silently disable the guard. This went undetected twice and cost PR #1956 a red round. Put rationale in Definition, then PRINT the parsed aliases and confirm each is a clean standalone string.
Do not add avoid-aliases beyond this issue's scope. An unrequested addition broke an unrelated agent prompt's worked example on #1956. Broader copy decisions belong to #1959.
A guard must be seen failing (.cursor/rules/code-quality.mdc, merged in #1976): print what the test collected, make it go red on purpose, report both.
Run the demo suite with `npx turbo run test --filter=@juli/demo --force` and report the `Cached:` line — a cached turbo task prints a full pass having run nothing.
Pin PYTHONPATH="$PWD/backend/src:$PWD" for any pytest run inside the worktree, or the green is fake.
